activity.notes: Barboncito was a prominent Diné (Navajo) chief and leader. The bounded ATLAS Activity begins with his firmly documented leadership in the 1868 treaty negotiations and ends with his death in 1871; it does not imply that Diné political authority was centralized in a single sovereign chief.

sources.title: Navajo Nation Treaty of 1868
sources.citation_text: The 1868 Treaty identifies the Navajo nation or tribe as represented by its chiefs and headmen and lists BARBONCITO first among the signatories with the designation Chief.

sources.title: The Navajo Treaties — National Museum of the American Indian
sources.citation_text: The Smithsonian NMAI identifies Barboncito and Manuelito as Diné leaders who negotiated on behalf of the Navajo in 1868 and pressed for return to their homelands.
